title: Names of Allah & Muhammad: Aud
meta_description: Names of Allah & Muhammad. This app helps you to memorize Allah's 99 names
full_description: Names of Allah and Muhammad is a free application to read and listen to the 99 Names of Allah (SWT) and Muhammad (PBUH)99 Names of Allah are the names of Allah (God). Each representing a certain attribute or description of Allah (God). Allah(SWT) says in the Quran: "He is Allah (God), the Creator, the Originator, The Fashioner, to Him belong the most beautiful names: whatever is in the heavens and on earth, do declare His praises and Glory. And He is the Exalted in Might, The Wise."The 99 names of God or 99 names of Allah (SWT) are the Names of God by which Muslims regard God (Allah) and which are described in the Quran, and Sunnah, amongst other places.According to a Sunni hadith, Sahih Muslim:Abu Hurairah reported Allah's Messenger (PBUH) as saying: "There are ninety-nine names of Allah; he who commits them to memory would get into Paradise."Features:• Read Names of Allah in Arabic and English• Listen Names of Allah in Arabic• Read meanings translation of these Names of Allah in English• Read Names of Muhammad in Arabic and English• Listen Names of Muhammad in Arabic• Read meanings translation of these Names of Muhammad in English• Mark your favorite names• Digital Tasbih• NotificationIf you have questions or others feedbacks, don’t hesitate to contact us by mail: studioesoft@gmail.com
